publication_rules: Raw identity copies preserve CRLF. Host path prefixes and temporary directories are redacted; isolated32hex lease IDs are replaced. XML placeholders are escaped. Projections use only listed fields. Private originals, owners, raw secure settings and their fingerprints are excluded. Unselected raw captures remain independently hash-listed.

Clear uses the selected system IME; native-input regression cases use the explicitly owned silent test IME. Constrained empty-feedback visibility remains open in#111; v7 scopes that body assertion, keeping all Clear assertions mandatory.
